_doc: What tools/coverage.py cannot work out alone (book: What the traces never touched).
regions: inclusive address ranges ($BB:AAAA) whose unknown bytes get this category and
subcategory (and owner, if given) instead of the automatic one; note says what they are.
size_words: a regex; an unknown 2-byte data line right before a label it matches is one of
the size words the ROM keeps before the sound CPU blocks (the upload lists carry the sizes).
code_groups / data_groups: [regex, group] tried in order on the routine (code never run)
or the owner label (data); the first match names the group.

regions.note: No code reads it, and neither does the console (emulators and copiers do).
COP, BRK, ABORT and the emulation-mode vectors are never taken; the power-on fetch of the reset vector is not in the traces (the CDL does mark the NMI and IRQ vectors read).
`ldx #$1280` after an rtl, with no label: unreachable.
